tests.name: Quick Check
tests.description: Timed check on Composition and Layout

questions.question: Create a series of experimental studies exploring composition and layout. Annotate your process.
questions.correctAnswer: A range of experimental studies showing different approaches to composition and layout, each annotated with media, technique and purpose. Show development from initial experiments to refined outcomes.

questions.question: Research an artist or designer who works with composition and layout. Write a critical analysis of their approach and explain how it has informed your own work.
questions.correctAnswer: A critical analysis naming a specific artist/designer, using specialist vocabulary, explaining their context and approach, and making clear connections to personal work.

questions.question: Evaluate the effectiveness of your experiments with composition and layout. Which approaches were most successful and why?
questions.correctAnswer: A reflective evaluation identifying successful and less successful experiments, explaining WHY using technical and conceptual language, and showing how evaluation led to further refinement.

tests.name: Extended Practice
tests.description: Self-marked extended answers on Composition and Layout

questions.question: Full-Mark Response Compare the compositions of two paintings from different periods. Analyse how each artist has arranged elements to create balance, focus and meaning. How has this influenced your own compositional decisions? <div class="
questions.correctAnswer: A grade 9 response will: use formal vocabulary (focal point, visual hierarchy, negative space, golden ratio); analyse how composition creates meaning; identify the type of balance used; explain how composition affects the viewer; make explicit links to personal compositional experiments. Mark scheme: AO1 (develop through investigation) + AO2 (refine through experimentation) + AO3 (record ideas and observations) + AO4 (present personal response) = total marks
questions.explanation: Extended answer: aim for the mark-scheme points, in order, with the command word addressed.
